title: Tiny, cute bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <!-- rear wheel -->
    <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='5'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='none'/>
    <!-- front wheel -->
    <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='5'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='none'/>
    <!-- spokes rear -->
    <g stroke='#8BE0FF' stroke-width='1.6'>
      <line x1='26' y1='52' x2='26' y2='84'/>
      <line x1='10' y1='68' x2='42' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='15' y1='57' x2='37' y2='79'/>
      <line x1='15' y1='79' x2='37' y2='57'/>
    </g>
    <!-- spokes front -->
    <g stroke='#8BE0FF' stroke-width='1.6'>
      <line x1='74' y1='52' x2='74' y2='84'/>
      <line x1='58' y1='68' x2='90' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='63' y1='57' x2='85' y2='79'/>
      <line x1='63' y1='79' x2='85' y2='57'/>
    </g>
    <!-- frame -->
    <g stroke='#FF7043' stroke-width='5' fill='none'>
      <line x1='26' y1='68' x2='46' y2='50'/>
      <line x1='46' y1='50' x2='60' y2='50'/>
      <line x1='60' y1='50' x2='74' y2='68'/>
      <line x1='26' y1='68' x2='60' y2='50'/>
      <line x1='60' y1='50' x2='60' y2='62'/>
      <line x1='46' y1='50' x2='46' y2='62'/>
    </g>
    <!-- seat -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='44' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#B388FF' stroke='none'/>
    <!-- handlebar -->
    <g stroke='#FFEB3B' stroke-width='4.5' fill='none'>
      <line x1='60' y1='50' x2='72' y2='38'/>
      <line x1='64' y1='36' x2='80' y2='40'/>
    </g>
    <!-- pedals -->
    <circle cx='53' cy='62' r='4' fill='#69F0AE' stroke='none'/>
    <!-- basket -->
    <rect x='68' y='42' width='14' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFD54F' stroke='none'/>
    <g stroke='#FFA000' stroke-width='1.4'>
      <line x1='71' y1='42' x2='71' y2='52'/>
      <line x1='75' y1='42' x2='75' y2='52'/>
      <line x1='79' y1='42' x2='79' y2='52'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
